scripts.buildAndSign: webpack && web-ext build && web-ext sign --api-key $(op item get WebExtSignInfo --account my.1password.com --fields label=username) --api-secret $(op item get WebExtSignInfo --account my.1password.com --fields label=password) && git add ./artifacts/*
scripts.test: DATA=$(op item get JiraMaxServ --account maxserv.1password.eu --fields label=username,label=password --format json) npx playwright test
scripts.testandreport: DATA=$(op item get JiraMaxServ --account maxserv.1password.eu --fields label=username,label=password --format json) npx playwright test && npx playwright show-report
